Senior Director, Translational R&D Linked in BlueSky Facebook Jim Niemi is a biomedical engineer with over 25 years of experience researching, developing, and commercializing high impact technologies. Prior to joining the Wyss Institute, Jim was involved in a series of medical device companies, ranging from small start-up ventures to large public companies.
